query.queryString:
declare query_parameters(startTime:datetime, endTime:datetime);
network_telemetry
| where event_time between (startTime .. endTime)
| where metric_name == "packet_loss_pct"
| join kind=inner (
    network_incident_bridge
    | where severity == "High"
) on network_asset_id
| project event_time, network_asset_id, metric_name, metric_value, severity_band, incident_id, region
